title: Move the gold oracle ten-fold
teach: ethPerGoldGram is a placeholder oracle with no source behind it. Overlaying a ten-fold jump changes nothing today, because v1's expansion vault holds ETH and never converts to gold — which is itself the finding: the oracle is declared but unwired, so nobody should read the gold column as a reserve claim yet.

actions.note: expansion close funds the expansion vault

expect.notesYellow: Placeholder oracle. The expansion vault holds ETH and never converts to gold in v1, so a 10x move in ethPerGoldGram has no effect on any balance. Treat the gold column as unimplemented, not as a reserve.
